test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two candidates appeared for an examination. The marks obtained by one candidate exceeded those of the other by 75 . Moreover, his score was equivalent to 80\% of the combined marks of both candidates. Determine the marks obtained by each candidate.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Candidate A marks to Total marks = 80% = 4 : 5

Candidate B marks = Total − Candidate A = 5 − 4 = 1 unit

Difference in marks = 4 − 1 = 3 units

Given 3 units = 75 ⇒ 1 unit = 25

Marks = 4 × 25 and 1 × 25 = 100 and 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25 and 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between marks = 75

Candidate A marks = 80% of (A + B)

**Formula:**

Percentage Value = (Part / Total) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1844e13b9e89ff65a48fff3da18839a30e9ff3a67b1b400237a67fecf63bf7f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total marks of both candidates be x.

⇒ Marks of Candidate A = 80% of x = 0.8x

⇒ Marks of Candidate B = x − 0.8x = 0.2x

⇒ Difference = 0.8x − 0.2x = 75

⇒ 0.6x = 75

⇒ x = 75 ÷ 0.6 = 125

⇒ Marks of Candidate A = 0.8 × 125 = 100

⇒ Marks of Candidate B = 0.2 × 125 = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25 and 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Ratio Conversion

To simplify calculations, convert percentages to fractions (e.g., 80% = 4/5, 20% = 1/5, 60% = 3/5).

Total Sum Concept

When one part is given as a percentage of the total, the other part is (100 − given percentage) of that same total.

Base Value Identification

Always identify whether the percentage is calculated on the total or on another individual value to avoid calculation errors.
